scope: Batch 3 — WWII-related decisions before national courts (France, Germany, Italy, Canada, Israel), plus Argentine and Canadian finds surfaced along the way. Sources: Légifrance/Judilibre, rechtsprechung-im-internet + NeuRIS + NRW/MV Land portals, Corte Costituzionale, Federal Court of Canada (A2AJ), Versa/Cardozo, CSJN sjconsulta.

decisions_for_existing_cases.case_id: argentina-astiz (corpus: Alfredo Ignacio Astiz — Dirty War)
decisions_for_existing_cases.court: Corte Suprema de Justicia de la Nación
decisions_for_existing_cases.reference: A. 538. XLVI (Astiz, Alfredo Ignacio s/ extradición)
decisions_for_existing_cases.note: CSJN ruling on France's extradition request for Astiz (refused at first instance by the Bahía Blanca federal court) — the Argentine side of the French in absentia conviction tracked by the corpus.
Immigration-inadmissibility ruling following Mungwarere's criminal acquittal — the administrative aftermath of the corpus case (criminal acquittal ≠ immigration clearance).

new_case_candidates_wwii.crimes: Crimes against humanity (deportations, Izieu children, persecution of resistants)
new_case_candidates_wwii.axes: imprescriptibility; CAH definition; disguised extradition; victims as civil parties

decisions.note: Detention upheld despite the 'disguised extradition' from Bolivia — male captus doctrine for crimes against humanity.

THE landmark: crimes against humanity defined as inhumane acts and persecutions committed in the name of a State practising a policy of ideological hegemony — extending protection to resistance members. Pourvoi by deportee/resistant associations.
Rejection of Barbie's pourvoi against the 4 July 1987 Rhône assize conviction (perpetuity) — conviction final.

new_case_candidates_wwii.case_name: Paul Touvier (France — Milice de Lyon, Rillieux-la-Pape)
new_case_candidates_wwii.axes: first French conviction of a Frenchman for CAH; state-agent requirement

decisions.note: Renvoi to the Yvelines assize court after cassation (the post-1992 revival of the case).
Rejection of Touvier's pourvoi against the 20 April 1994 perpetuity conviction — the first final French CAH conviction of a Vichy official.

new_case_candidates_wwii.axes: complicity of a civil servant; no requirement of adherence to the perpetrators' ideology

decisions.note: Rejection of Papon's pourvoi against his renvoi to the Gironde assize court — complicity in CAH does not require the accomplice's adherence to the ideology of the principal perpetrators.

new_case_candidates_wwii.case_name: Jean Leguay (France — Vél d'Hiv roundup, first CAH indictment)
new_case_candidates_wwii.axes: first person indicted for CAH in France (1979); died before trial (1989)

decisions.note: Arrêt in the CAH information opened against 'Jean X...' (chambre d'accusation Paris, 3 July 1981) — matches the Leguay instruction; verify identity before ingestion.

new_case_candidates_wwii.axes: accessory liability through camp service (post-Demjanjuk doctrine); enforcement vs. old age

decisions.reference: BGH, 20 Sept 2016, 3 StR 49/16 (Leitsatz: 'Beihilfe zum Mord durch Dienst im Konzentrationslager Auschwitz')
decisions.note: Revision dismissed against LG Lüneburg, 15 July 2015 — the leading decision cementing accessory-to-murder liability for any function sustaining an extermination camp.

Constitutional complaint rejected: enforcing the prison sentence against the 96-year-old convict compatible with the right to life and physical integrity. Anonymised — matches the Gröning enforcement litigation; verify.
Full judgment text on the official NRW portal — 5 years for guard service at Auschwitz I (Hanning died in 2017 before the revision was decided).

new_case_candidates_wwii.crimes: Accessory to murder in over 10,000 cases (juvenile law — she was 18-19 at the time)
new_case_candidates_wwii.axes: civilian employee liability; last NS trials

decisions.note: Revision dismissed against LG Itzehoe, 20 Dec 2022 — first BGH ruling extending camp-service accessory liability to a CIVILIAN employee (the commandant's typist). Probably the last NS-crimes judgment ever.

new_case_candidates_wwii.case_name: Hubert Zafke proceedings — survivors' co-prosecution rulings (Germany)
new_case_candidates_wwii.crimes: Accessory to murder (Auschwitz medic — proceedings terminated for unfitness)
new_case_candidates_wwii.axes: victims' rights (Nebenklage standing of survivors and relatives)

decisions.note: Co-plaintiff (Nebenkläger) standing of bereaved relatives in NS mass-killing prosecutions — a victims'-rights ruling in the Neubrandenburg Auschwitz-medic proceedings. Companion: 20 Ws 75/16 (25 April 2016).

new_case_candidates_wwii.crimes: War crimes (participation in the Ardeatine Caves massacre, 335 victims)

decisions.note: Constitutional challenge to the 1953 amnesty raised by the Military Appeals Court in the Priebke proceedings — the constitutional layer of the case. The Argentine CSJN extradition ruling (2 Nov 1995, Fallos 318:2148) is NOT in LDH (CSJN open data does not reach 1995).

new_case_candidates_wwii.case_name: Sentenza 238/2014 (Italy — state immunity vs. Nazi-era victims)
new_case_candidates_wwii.crimes: War crimes and crimes against humanity (civil reparations claims)
new_case_candidates_wwii.axes: immunity (core); victims' access to court; national court vs. ICJ

decisions.note: The Constitutional Court refuses to give effect to the ICJ's Jurisdictional Immunities judgment insofar as it denies Nazi-era victims access to a judge — the most consequential national ruling on immunity vs. victims' rights.

new_case_candidates_wwii.crimes: Concealment of wartime SS service (citizenship revocation)
new_case_candidates_wwii.axes: the Canadian post-Finta route: revocation and deportation instead of prosecution

decisions.note: Citizenship-revocation reference against an alleged SS concentration-camp guard — exemplar of Canada's WWII denaturalization litigation after criminal prosecution collapsed with R v. Finta.

new_case_candidates_wwii.crimes: Incitement to genocide and crimes against humanity (immigration law)
new_case_candidates_wwii.axes: speech as CAH; removal vs. prosecution

decisions.note: Federal Court stage of the saga over Mugesera's 1992 speech.
Final removal-stage ruling before his January 2012 deportation to Rwanda. The SCC's landmark 2005 judgment (2005 SCC 40) is NOT indexed in LDH — link via CanLII/Lexum when ingesting.

coverage_notes: UK: the National Archives Find Case Law index starts ~2001 — the Pinochet House of Lords rulings (1998-1999) and Sawoniuk (2000) are not indexed; keep the corpus's existing sources.

ISRAEL: Versa (Cardozo) carries the kapo-trial line (Berenblat) but not the Eichmann appeal (Crim.A. 336/61) or Demjanjuk (Crim.A. 347/88) — the Israeli State Archives / Nizkor texts remain the sources for those.
CANADA: only Federal Court decisions are indexed — R v. Finta (SCC 1994) and Mugesera (SCC 2005) must be linked via Lexum/CanLII.
AUSTRALIA: Polyukhovich v. Commonwealth (HCA 1991) not reachable — the indexed AU sources are recent.
ARGENTINA: CSJN open data does not reach the Priebke extradition (1995); Simón (2005) and Arancibia Clavel (2004) are the earliest key texts confirmed available.

FRANCE watchlist: Cass. crim. 25 Nov 1986, n° 86-92.714 (prescription cassation, Lyon, civil party 'Lise veuve Y...') sits in the Barbie/Touvier orbit — identify before use; Cass. crim. 12 Feb 2003, n° 02-86.531 may belong to the Aussaresses (Algeria torture apologia) line already in the corpus.
